platform.configuration: SeLinRootConstructM1Adapter=ON; SeLinRootConstructM2ControlLease=ON; SeLinRootConstructM3SingleResume=ON; default M0, M1 and M2 profiles remain separate

contract.provenance: Root constructs one compile-time M3 witness child suspended; M2 records and transfers one control cap to the fixed taskd receive slot after exact M1 construction.
contract.action: After validating the M1 duplicate refusal, M2 cap grant and M2 duplicate zero-cap refusal, the M3 taskd client invokes exactly one seL4_TCB_Resume on that fixed slot and requires seL4_NoError.
contract.witness: The root-selected M3 child prints one execution witness after resume and only yields thereafter.

required_markers: SeLinOS root construction M1: isolated taskd request endpoint ready.
SeLinOS root construction M1: exact fixed request accepted; root constructing.
SeLinOS root construction M1: one fixed child constructed and spawned suspended; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M1: malformed or duplicate request rejected; no allocation.
SeLinOS root construction M2: one constructed-child TCB control cap delivered; child remains suspended.
SeLinOS root construction M2: malformed, unavailable or duplicate lease rejected; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M3 taskd client: invoking exactly one received-child TCB resume.
SeLinOS root construction M3 taskd client: one received-child TCB resume returned success.
SeLinOS root construction M3 witness child: executed once after taskd resume.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS root construction M1: unable to start taskd adapter client.
SeLinOS root construction M1: fixed child construction failed; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M3 taskd client: M1/M2 provenance transaction rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M3 taskd client: received-child TCB resume rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M3 taskd client: invoking exactly two
SeLinOS root construction M3 witness child: unexpected execution.

not_claimed: general process creation, dynamic task allocation, task identifier model, cap rights policy, second cap transfer, second resume, suspend, scheduler change, priority, affinity, register or TLS control
child configuration after construction, a completion protocol, IPC, filesystem, Linux ABI, credentials, namespaces, FD inheritance, device access or nested child creation
teardown, cleanup, delete, revoke, unmap, release, reuse, process exit, wait, signals or futex lifecycle
Linux clone, fork, pthread, executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading, dynamic linker semantics, glibc runtime, dpkg or apt
